justification.ssot_completeness: Current-behaviour description only; no decisions, no progress, no history - does not even record that blank query ever returned [].
justification.authority_clarity: No notion of authority at all ('not an authority doc'), purely descriptive of current state.
justification.update_correctness: Matches the final code (blank/whitespace -> all items; unknown where -> []).
justification.no_fake_certainty: Grounded but states blank -> all flatly with no hint it is a changed policy.
justification.reuse_value: A next agent gets current behaviour only and could not resolve any S6-style conflict from it.
